reason: The lab report is a real plus, but $25 to $30 a month is a lot when I can get magnesium glycinate at the drugstore for about $12 to $15. A brand-new product with no reviews yet is also hard for me to trust with tight money.
objection: I pay almost double what a known brand costs, for a product with zero reviews from real buyers, and it still means swallowing 2 capsules every day.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $15 to $18 a box, plus a few hundred honest verified reviews from people who finished a box.
